spacing_method: Exact minimum Euclidean distance between yaw-rotated rectangular walls. Every non-exempt building is included; clusters are connected components at 15 m. Party walls count as zero. Landmarks, gatehouse and working-yard structures alone are exempt.
rotation_contract: footprint stores the unrotated rectangle centred in world x,z. Rotate local offsets about its centre by yaw_deg using x=c*x-s*z, z=s*x+c*z. Godot rotation.y=-deg_to_rad(yaw_deg). door_position is already world-space. Face names are local. Clockwise on the north-up plan (positive z is south). yaw is a multiple of five degrees.
